primary.title: SGB 2018-19 Series III final redemption today: Investors to earn up to 348% return; check RBI fixed price, interest rate
primary.summary: Sovereign Gold Bonds: SGB 2018-19 Series III completes its eight-year tenure on Friday, 13 November. Investors stand to earn up to 348% in capital gains, excluding interest income. Check how the RBI-fixed redemption price translates into investment gains and how much interest you can earn.
